meta_description: A couple reflects on fostering 13 children and the profound moment when each one calls their house home for the first time.
summary_short: A foster couple shares why their greatest reward isn't gratitude or recognition—it's the simple, powerful moment when a child first calls their place 'home'.
body:
A couple who have fostered 13 children say their greatest reward is hearing each one call their house home. For families opening their doors to children in need, the emotional payoff goes far beyond recognition or thanks. Instead, it comes in those quiet, ordinary moments when a child who has known instability finally begins to belong.

Fostering demands patience, resources, and an uncommon willingness to love children through uncertain futures. Yet this couple's perspective reveals something essential: the truest measure of their work isn't counted in accolades or milestones. It's found in a single word—home—spoken with the security and peace that only a safe, caring environment can provide.
quick_facts: Greatest reward: hearing children call it 'home'
Reflects deep emotional impact of foster care
